title: Beyond Accuracy: Measuring Logical Compliance of Predictive Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.20208v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine learning models are predominantly evaluated through predictive performance metrics such as ranking quality, prediction error, or classification accuracy. While these metrics effectively quantify how closely predictions match the ground truth, they do not assess whether model outputs respect predefined logical or domain-specific constraints. In high-stakes applications, including healthcare, finance, and autonomous systems, logical consistency can be as critical as predictive accuracy, yet no standard metric captures this dimension. We introduce the Rule Violation Score (RVS), a complementary evaluation metric that quantifies the extent to which a predictive model respects a given set of logical rules, independently of predictive accuracy. translated_title: 超越准确性：衡量预测模型的逻辑合规性
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型目前主要通过预测性能指标进行评估，例如排序质量、预测误差或分类准确率。虽然这些指标能有效量化预测结果与真实值的匹配程度，但它们无法评估模型输出是否遵守预定义的逻辑约束或领域特定约束。在医疗、金融和自动驾驶系统等高风险应用中，逻辑一致性与预测准确性同等重要，然而目前尚无标准指标能够衡量这一维度。我们提出了规则违反分数，这是一种补充性评估指标，用于量化预测模型遵守给定逻辑规则集的程度，且独立于预测准确性。RVS对硬规则（严格约束）和软规则（统计规律）采取区别处理方式，可以在任何数据集以及任何以关系词汇表达的预测模型上进行评估。
tldr: 本文提出了规则违反分数（RVS），一种独立于预测准确性、可量化预测模型遵守逻辑规则程度的补充性评估指标，填补了高风险应用中缺乏逻辑一致性标准度量方法的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Rule Violation Score (RVS), a complementary evaluation metric that quantifies the extent to which predictive models comply with a given set of logical rules independently of predictive accuracy, addressing the absence of standard metrics for logical consistency in high-stakes applications.
